rationale: Read the complete original and final shared host harness. It injects transport/native ports into the real createBridgeHost and reads every emitted frame through the actual page reader. Add observed native-handler calls so refusal cases prove zero native dispatch, and register/dispose every created host after each test. This is fixture support, not an independent runnable suite.
validation: Selected consumers plus browser-screencast-budget-at-the-shell: 49 suites /621 tests passed. All six mutation production files restored. Mobile test typecheck, lint, format and code quality passed.
limitations: Native methods and transport are injected; this fixture does not prove real device clipboard/media behavior. Successful non-clipboard native cases must provide a valid per-verb override.
Fixed route/identity values are fixture inputs; actual bridge grants, ownership, admission, disposal and frame parsing remain production behavior.
